super_solver_analogize.description: Retrieves cross-domain structural analogies using Vector Symbolic Architecture (VSA) / Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) and Gentner's Structure-Mapping Engine.

specification.description: Description of the target system or challenge to find analogies for

super_solver_decompose.description: Decomposes a difficult research or engineering problem into auxiliary angles. First IDENTIFIES the problem (type/entities/givens/unknowns/constraints/goal), then generates subproblems anchored on those slots via Polya heuristics and TRIZ inventive principles. Returns problem_structure, ranked auxiliary_angles, suggested_triz_operators and decomposition_metrics (slot coverage, relevance spread).

initial_subproblems.description: Known subproblems or aspects already identified

topic.description: The problem or research topic to decompose

super_solver_deflect.description: Evaluates if a proposed approach or finding is in the attraction basin of known dead ends, and computes geometric deflection in continuous representation space.

known_dead_ends.description: List of known failed approaches / dead ends

proposed_content.description: The idea, angle, or finding to test

super_solver_identify.description: Identifies a problem's structure: problem type (optimization/proof/search/estimation/design/diagnosis/explanation), entities, givens, unknowns, constraints, goal and success criteria. Use BEFORE decomposition to see how the engine understands the problem.

super_solver_kt_boundary.description: Applies Kepner-Tregoe IS / IS-NOT 4D boundary separation to isolate root cause or system failure envelope.

is_not_facts.description: Facts that COULD be true but ARE NOT

super_solver_next_experiment.description: Ranks candidate experiment designs using Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (BOED) by cost-penalized Expected Information Gain.

candidate_designs.description: List of experiment design dicts with design_id, name, parameters, cost

hypothesis_priors.description: Mapping from hypothesis ID to prior probability float

likelihood_matrix.description: Nested mapping: design_id -> outcome -> hypothesis_id -> float

super_solver_pareto.description: Resolves a multi-objective trade-off: given objectives (with direction) and candidate solutions scored on each, returns the non-dominated Pareto frontier, the knee/compromise point, a scalarized ranking, and which objective pairs actually trade off.

weights.description: Optional objective weights for the scalarized ranking

super_solver_primitive_analogize.description: Performs cross-domain analogical transfer by extracting structural primitives (action + object atoms) and computing overlap with stored solutions. Overcomes surface cosine similarity limits.

specification.description: Description of the target system to analogize

top_k.description: Number of cross-domain analogs to retrieve

super_solver_suggest_paths.description: Suggests next optimal exploratory or reasoning paths avoiding dead ends using continuous thought guidance.

super_solver_triz_solve.description: Uses Altshuller's TRIZ contradiction matrix to resolve trade-offs between improving and worsening parameters.

improving_parameter.description: What property or parameter needs to be improved

worsening_parameter.description: What property deteriorates as a side-effect
